title: Discipline Lead – Mechanical (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Mechanical BIM content as it relates to animated figures, mechanical show action equipment, structural interfaces, and documentation delivery.
authority_statements: Approve or reject Mechanical discipline BIM states for use in technical and documentation milestones
Sign-off authority for Mechanical documentation readiness
Authority bounded by Mechanical scope and enterprise standards
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
responsibilities: Ensure Mechanical BIM models support accurate mechanical layouts, details, and clearance zones
Align Mechanical resources with project milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve kinetic envelopes and maintenance access
Formally approve Mechanical BIM models for documentation use based on externalized data
Review Mechanical data completeness using CSV/Excel extracts
accountabilities: Mechanical BIM content suitability for documentation outputs (equipment layouts, dynamic envelopes, anchor details)
Mechanical participation in BIM coordination workflows
Mechanical BIM deliverables meeting milestone commitments
approvals: Mechanical discipline BIM model states approved for documentation use
Mechanical drawing packages and equipment schedules
inputs: Mechanical engineering calculations, kinematics, and load specifications
BEP and coordination rules from Project BIM Manager / Coordinator
outputs: Mechanical equipment drawings, kinetic envelopes, and schedules
